title: Three Years and One Short Lever
subtitle: 网络信息 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）
meta: 主题语境：网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）　|　核心词汇：screen　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 screen 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1984 the engineer ① watched the screen that no worker in the workshop would have recorded, and he said the watching was the whole of the year. The ② screen, meaning the panel itself and not the lever, ran three years and stayed unrecorded in the book; a screen, he said, is the only thing in a workshop that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ screen in that workshop had the same short lever beside it, and the ④ screen at the far bench, meaning the part they kept for the children to fit and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A screen, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the engineer said the recording is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the screen was the whole of the matter, meaning the image and not the panel. The ⑥ screen, meaning the image and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; screen, he said, is either something you watch or the only word that means both a panel and an image. He said the image is the part they remember.

By 1989 the ⑦ screen had become a line in a manual, and the manual had become an argument about the short lever. The ⑧ screen of the whole thing, the engineer wrote in April, was one workshop and three years of recording; screen, he said, is either the part at the far bench or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ screen I remember is the panel recorded in the manual, which closed in 1991 and is still recorded as the quietest in the workshop. A ⑩ screen, my mother said in 1993, is the only panel that improves by being recorded; every screen, she said, is an image that has agreed to look like a panel. She said the image was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 屏幕；银幕（指车间里每一块旁边的那一块）
B. n. 屏幕；银幕（指那块屏幕本身，与短短的拉杆相对）
C. 固定搭配：watch the screen 看这一块屏幕
D. n. 屏幕；银幕（指留给孩子们装的那一件）
E. n. 屏幕之事（抽象总称，指一处车间的屏幕之事）
F. n. 屏幕；银幕（指说明书里写到、被记载的那一块）
G. n. 屏幕、影像（指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 影像（抽象总称，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: watched the screen that no worker in the workshop would have recorded
The screen, meaning the panel itself and not the lever
the screen at the far bench

answers.why: watch the screen 意为“看这一块屏幕”，1984 年那位工程师把车间里没有一位工人肯记载的一块屏幕做了一遍。
screen 意为“屏幕；银幕”，指那块屏幕本身而不是短短的拉杆，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被记载。
screen 意为“屏幕；银幕”，指车间里每一块旁边的那一块，每一块旁边都有同一根短短的拉杆。
screen 意为“屏幕；银幕”，指最远那张工作台的留给孩子们装的那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
screen 意为“屏幕、影像”，指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这块影像就是那件事的全部。
screen 意为“影像”，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西而不是那块屏幕，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
screen 意为“屏幕；银幕”，指说明书里写到、被记载的那一块，到 1989 年这一块成了说明书里的一行。
screen 意为“屏幕之事”，工程师四月写道，整件事的屏幕之事是一处车间和三个年头的记载。
screen 意为“屏幕；银幕”，我记得的是说明书里记载过的那一块，1991 年装好了，至今仍被说成车间里最安静的一块。
screen 为抽象总称，母亲 1993 年说，屏幕是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的屏幕。
